description: This file implements histogramming for RPC statistics collection, defining a histogram type with methods for measurement, aggregation, statistical analysis, and visualization.

classes.name: histogram
classes.description: A data structure for collecting and analyzing histogram data for RPC statistics.

methods.name: addMeasurement
methods.description: Records a new measurement value into the histogram.

methods.name: allocateBuckets
methods.description: Initializes the buckets array for the histogram.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns the total number of recorded observations.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates the average of recorded values.

methods.name: variance
methods.description: Calculates the variance of recorded values.

methods.name: standardDeviation
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of recorded values.

methods.name: percentileBoundary
methods.description: Estimates the value at a given percentile.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Aggregates another histogram into this one.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the histogram to an empty state.

methods.name: Multiply
methods.description: Scales the histogram by a ratio.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the histogram.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Returns an HTML visualization of the histogram.
